name: Whispers in a Coma
source:
You play as a silent listener. You awake in a strange white room abandoned with a paralyzed body and what happened before is a mystery. But an even bigger mystery is ... Aeon.

[From [url=https://aster-zerone.itch.io/whispers-in-a-coma]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个沉默的倾听者。你在一个奇怪的白色房间里醒来，房间里有一具瘫痪的身体，而之前发生的事情是一个谜。但更大的谜团是……Aeon。

[来自[url=https://aster-zerone.itch.io/whispers-in-a-coma]itch.io[/url]]
